trajectory_summary: This call never leaves the roof/trees qualifier — the rep skips the interest question, utility, bill, and every other verify item and lets the customer's shading concern become the entire conversation. Energy leaks steadily from neutral to resigned as the rep validates the customer's own pessimism instead of redirecting toward an appointment or specialist. It ends with no next step, no callback time, and no bill captured.
outcome_dispute: v1 tag is unknown/unclear; this should be read as no_appointment — the call ends on 'you have a wonderful day' with only a vague 'give me a callback' offer, no owned next step.

observed_outcome.quote: K. Awesome. Well, you have a wonderful day.
observed_outcome.reasoning: Call ends with no day, time, or callback commitment owned by the rep — only a vague invitation for the customer to call back if he decides to remove a tree.

bill_anchor_audit.reasoning: No monthly bill amount or kWh usage was requested or provided in the call.

bill_document_audit.reasoning: The rep never asked for the utility bill or a photo/link during the call.

interest_reason_audit.reasoning: The rep did not ask why the customer was interested in solar, and the customer did not volunteer a motivating reason.
